options: Ensuring service components are available, when and where needed, to agreed specification — whether built in-house or acquired from a supplier
Running the service desk's day-to-day ticket queue
Writing the organization's long-term strategic architecture
Defining what counts as an incident versus a problem
questions.explain: Obtain/build's stated purpose centers on component availability and meeting agreed specification, regardless of make-or-buy source.

questions.q: What is the Deliver & support activity's purpose?
options: To decide whether a component should be built in-house or bought from a supplier
To ensure services are delivered and supported according to agreed specifications and stakeholder expectations, day to day
To design the specification a new service must meet before it ships
To negotiate supplier contracts on the organization's behalf
questions.explain: Deliver & support is the continuous, operational activity that keeps services running and supported once they're live.

questions.q: Which practice defines what 'agreed specifications' means in measurable terms for a service?
options: Change enablement
Release management
Service level management
Continual improvement
questions.explain: Service level management, covered fully in Chapter 5, is what turns 'agreed specifications' into measurable targets.

questions.q: According to this lesson, how can Deliver & support create new demand for Obtain/build?
options: It never can — demand only flows from Obtain/build to Deliver & support
By replacing the need for a make-or-buy decision entirely
By taking over supplier contract negotiation directly
By noticing a component isn't holding up — a slipping supplier response time, a license limit, hardware nearing end of support — which becomes new demand to re-source or replace it
questions.explain: The relationship between these two activities runs both directions; day-to-day support work routinely surfaces new sourcing needs.

questions.q: Why do ITIL 4 Foundation exam questions often test the difference between Design & transition, Obtain/build, and Deliver & support?
options: Because Design & transition is about getting something ready, Obtain/build is about sourcing the pieces to spec, and Deliver & support is about running it continuously once live — distinct accountabilities that can all touch the same service at once
Because only one of the three activities is real; the others are deprecated
Because they always occur in strict calendar-quarter order
Because Deliver & support is simply a renamed version of Obtain/build
questions.explain: These three activities have distinct, well-defined accountabilities that can overlap on the same service simultaneously, which is exactly what the exam tests.
